messages:
Sam (Sales): Heads-up: Orion Labs sent an RFI asking for a capability matrix + POC plan. Need a short deliverable pack by EOD Wed. They want: feature mapping, SLA, compliance answers, a 2-week POC pricing estimate, and perf numbers for a 100k token/day chat workload.
Ian (SE): Copy. Do we have a quick matrix we can re-use? I can fill model/latency rows.
Priya (Solutions): I can own the POC deliverables list (test harness, eval prompts, success criteria). Will need SE to provide perf targets and Eng to confirm supported deployment modes.
Lena (Security): I need to see answers for data residency, encryption (at-rest, in-transit), KMS/HSM support, access controls, and audit logs. Also: do they require FedRAMP?
Sam (Sales): They called out EU data residency + HSM for key escrow optional. FedRAMP not required but they ask about enterprise controls.
Tom (Engineering): For matrix rows: Hosted API, Dedicated (reserved), Private (VPC/on-prem); streaming support; batching; KV cache; quantization levels; model variants + rollout; SLA (p99 latency), and isolation. Quick draft numbers: Hosted p99 gen latency 120-300ms/token (depends on model), Dedicated 80-180ms/token, Private depends on infra.
Ian (SE): For the perf test I propose a simple harness: 5 concurrent chat sessions, 128-token prompt + 512-token responses, sustained over 10k requests to measure mean/p95/p99. Command we usually share:
```
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate -d '{"model":"rwd-v1-large","prompt":"<chat>","max_tokens":512}'
```
Tom (Engineering): That curl is fine for a sanity check. For accurate p99 use our load runner: `tools/load-runner --model rwd-v1-large --concurrency 5 --rate 20 --seq 640`. I can run this on Dedicated staging cluster and drop a results CSV.
Priya (Solutions): POC pricing ask: they want a 2-week Dedicated POC estimate (including reserved capacity + ingress/egress). Can sales give target budget?
Sam (Sales): They're flexible but gave a budget ballpark of $25k-$40k for the POC. Need a line-item quote: reserved nodes, storage, support, and optional HSM.
Lena (Security): For the questionnaire: baseline responses: SOC2 Type II (yes), encryption AES-256 at-rest (yes), TLS 1.2+/mTLS for private (yes), KMS with customer-managed keys (yes), HSM integration: supported on Private with partner HSMs (note: implementation lead time). I will draft short answers and attach the cert snapshots.
Tom (Engineering): Attachment: I'll upload the sample perf CSV and a one-page matrix snippet to the thread once done. Expect ~3 latency curves (short, med, long sequences).
ops-bot: file uploaded: rfi_orion_perf_results_176752.csv
Priya (Solutions): Deliverables checklist for RFI pack: 1) Capability matrix (table), 2) POC plan + timeline, 3) Pricing worksheet, 4) Security questionnaire answers, 5) Perf artifacts (CSV + graphs), 6) Example contract excerpt. I'll compile into a zip.
Ian (SE): I'll fill the capability matrix rows for SDK support (REST/SDKs), streaming, function calling, embeddings, reranking, and example throughput numbers.
Sam (Sales): Great. Who can own the final zip upload? Need it in the RFP binder + send to Orion contact (emily@orionlabs.com) by 5pm Wed.
Lena (Security): I'll own the security Qs and cert screenshots. Heads-up: HSM integration note must say "requires customer infra or on-prem partner; 4-6 week lead time".
Tom (Engineering): Uploaded: snippet_matrix_v1.xlsx and perf_curves.png to internal file store. ops-bot should confirm.
ops-bot: file uploaded: snippet_matrix_v1.xlsx
Sam (Sales): Thanks everyone. Quick sync tomorrow 10:00 to review the pack before send. If someone can't make it ping here with updates. :thumbsup:
